Case note: Petition No. 1041/2024
Client: Sanjay Natarajan (schoolteacher, Ahmedabad)
Opposing party: Madhuri Joshi
Court: Family Court at Ahmedabad
Filed on: 12 October 2024
Claim amount: ₹7,05,000
Issue: divorce by mutual consent. The spouses agree on a single payment instead of maintenance.
Advice given: Record the one-time alimony settlement in the consent terms.
Outcome: The settlement was recorded and the divorce granted.
Recommended next step: Transfer the settlement amount before the decree.
Witness: Karthik Rane
